Kristen Breitweiser, a widow of the September 11 attacks, joins Tucker Carlson to charge a cover-up. The title names Building 7 and what she calls a billion dollar scam to rob victims. She has fought the state on this case for years.

Breitweiser tells how the widows forced the first probe and what it left out. She argues funds meant for victims were bent to other ends. Carlson asks who she holds to blame most. Listeners hear the case from a woman who lost her husband that day. The library keeps the talk as a record of her stated claims.
